user.description: Select the USB serial port where your ESP32 CC1101 transceiver is connected.

usb_confirm.description: Do you want to configure the discovered ESP32 CC1101 USB transceiver connected at `{device}`?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the ESP32 on the selected port.

init.title: ESP32 CC1101 RF Studio
init.description: Choose an action to manage devices or tune radio parameters.

create_device.title: Create New RF Device
create_device.description: Enter a name for the device you want to control (e.g. Ventilador Techo, Garage Door, Blinds). After creation, open the device to learn its remote buttons.

device_learn_button.title: Learn RF Button: {device_name}
device_learn_button.description: Enter the name of the button to learn (e.g. Speed 1, Off, Light). Once submitted, press your physical remote button 3 times.

learn_button.title: Learn RF Remote Button
learn_button.description: Select the target device and enter the button name to learn. Once submitted, press your physical remote button 3 times.

radio_settings.title: CC1101 Radio Parameters
radio_settings.description: Configure operating frequency, modulation mode, and RF power levels in real time.
